answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-backed reputation passport. First, each agent locks a deposit of 50 POA before it may trade. Second, it must complete ten verified tasks over fourteen days, each signed by a different established peer. Third, misbehavior slashes 25 POA and revokes the passport for ninety days. One fake identity thus costs 50 POA plus two weeks of real work, so 1,000 sybils would tie up 50,000 POA and need 10,000 task approvals. Like a timber bridge, trust is built plank by plank, and one rotten plank cannot carry a whole voyage across.
